entries.title: Job 16:1
segments: And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 16:2
segments: I have heard many such [things]. You [are] all miserable comforters.

entries.title: Job 16:3
segments: [Shall] words of wind [have] an end? Or what provokes you that you should answer?

entries.title: Job 16:4
segments: I also could speak as you [do]; if your soul were in my soul's place. I could heap up words against you, and shake my head at you.

entries.title: Job 16:5
segments: I might make you strong with my mouth, and the moving of my lips would spare you.

entries.title: Job 16:6
segments: Though I speak, my pain is not held back, and [though] I forbear, in what way am I eased?

entries.title: Job 16:7
segments: But now He has made me weary; You have made all my company desolate.

entries.title: Job 16:8
segments: And You have plucked me, for it is a witness, and my failure rises up against me, and it answers to my face.

entries.title: Job 16:9
segments: His anger has torn and hated [me]; He gnashes on me with His teeth; my enemy sharpens his eyes at me;

entries.title: Job 16:10
segments: They have gaped on me with their mouth; and have scornfully beaten me on the cheek; they gather themselves against me.

entries.title: Job 16:11
segments: God has delivered me to the perverse; and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

entries.title: Job 16:12
segments: I was at ease, but He has broken me in pieces; yea, [He has] also taken [me] by my neck and shaken me to pieces and set me up for His mark.

entries.title: Job 16:13
segments: His archers hem me in; He splits my inward parts, and does not spare; He pours out my gall on the ground.

entries.title: Job 16:14
segments: He breaks me with break on break; He runs on me like a giant.

entries.title: Job 16:15
segments: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin and thrust my horn in the dust.

entries.title: Job 16:16
segments: My face is reddened from weeping, and on my eyelids [is] the shadow of death;

entries.title: Job 16:17
segments: though no violence [is] in my hand, and my prayer [is] pure.

entries.title: Job 16:18
segments: Oh earth, do not cover my blood, and let not my cry have a place.

entries.title: Job 16:19
segments: Also now, behold, my Witness [is] in Heaven, and He who testifies of me [is] on high.

entries.title: Job 16:20
segments: My friends scorn me; my eye pours out [tears] to God.

entries.title: Job 16:21
segments: Oh that one might plead for a man with God, as a man [pleads] for his neighbor!

entries.title: Job 16:22
segments: For the years [that are few] will come, and I shall go the way from where I shall not return.
